This ability cannot pass on a status ailment that the Pokémon did not directly receive from another Pokémon, such as the poison from Toxic Spikes or the burn from a Flame Orb. Overworld: If the lead Pokémon has this ability, wild Pokémon have a 50% chance of having the lead Pokémon's nature, and a 50% chance of being given a random nature as usual, including the lead Pokémon's nature. This does not work on Pokémon received outside of battle or roaming legendaries.
synchronize.flavor: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

ice-fang.shortEffect: Has a chance to freeze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
ice-fang.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

ice-punch.name: Ice Punch
ice-punch.shortEffect: Has a chance to freeze the target.
ice-punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

icicle-spear.name: Icicle Spear
icicle-spear.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

icy-wind.name: Icy Wind
icy-wind.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
icy-wind.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

iron-defense.name: Iron Defense
iron-defense.shortEffect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.
iron-defense.effect: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

iron-head.name: Iron Head
iron-head.shortEffect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
iron-head.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

knock-off.name: Knock Off
knock-off.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

lash-out.name: Lash Out
lash-out.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

leaf-storm.name: Leaf Storm
leaf-storm.shortEffect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
leaf-storm.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

leech-life.name: Leech Life
leech-life.shortEffect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
leech-life.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

light-screen.name: Light Screen
light-screen.shortEffect: Reduces damage from special attacks by 50% for five turns.
light-screen.effect: Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from special attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier. If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns. Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

liquidation.name: Liquidation
liquidation.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
liquidation.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

low-kick.name: Low Kick
low-kick.shortEffect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
low-kick.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

low-sweep.name: Low Sweep
low-sweep.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
low-sweep.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage after inflicting damage.
lunge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

magical-leaf.name: Magical Leaf
magical-leaf.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

metal-claw.name: Metal Claw
metal-claw.shortEffect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
metal-claw.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

metal-sound.name: Metal Sound
metal-sound.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
metal-sound.effect: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

meteor-beam.name: Meteor Beam
meteor-beam.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

misty-explosion.name: Misty Explosion
misty-explosion.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

misty-terrain.name: Misty Terrain
misty-terrain.shortEffect: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion, and halves the power of incoming Dragon moves.
misty-terrain.effect: For five turns, protects all Pokémon on the ground from major status ailments and confusion and weakens Dragon moves used against them to 0.5× their power. Changes Nature Power to Moonblast.

mud-shot.name: Mud Shot
mud-shot.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
mud-shot.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

mud-slap.name: Mud Slap
mud-slap.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
mud-slap.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

muddy-water.name: Muddy Water
muddy-water.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
muddy-water.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

night-shade.name: Night Shade
night-shade.shortEffect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
night-shade.effect: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.shortEffect: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
outrage.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.shortEffect: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
overheat.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

pain-split.name: Pain Split
pain-split.shortEffect: Sets the user’s and targets’s HP to the average of their current HP.
pain-split.effect: Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken. This effect fails against a Substitute.

phantom-force.name: Phantom Force
phantom-force.shortEffect: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn. Hits through Protect and Detect.
phantom-force.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

play-rough.name: Play Rough
play-rough.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
play-rough.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

poison-jab.name: Poison Jab
poison-jab.shortEffect: Has a chance to poison the target.
poison-jab.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

poison-tail.name: Poison Tail
poison-tail.shortEffect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
poison-tail.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

pollen-puff.name: Pollen Puff
pollen-puff.shortEffect: Damages opponents, but heals allies for 50% of their max HP.
pollen-puff.effect: If the target is an opponent, inflicts regular damage. If the target is an ally, heals the target for 50% of its max HP.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

power-gem.name: Power Gem
power-gem.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

protect.name: Protect
protect.shortEffect: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
protect.effect: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

psybeam.name: Psybeam
psybeam.shortEffect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
psybeam.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

psych-up.name: Psych Up
psych-up.shortEffect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.
psych-up.effect: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

psychic-fangs.name: Psychic Fangs
psychic-fangs.effect: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

psychic-terrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychic-terrain.shortEffect: Protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and increases the power of their Psychic moves by 50%.
psychic-terrain.effect: Changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain for 5 turns. Overrides Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, and Misty Terrain. All Pokémon on the ground are immune to moves with priority greater than 0. (Moves that target the field rather than individual Pokémon, such as Spikes, are not affected.) Additionally, when a Pokémon on the ground uses a Psychic-type move, that move’s power is increased to 1.5×. If a Pokémon is holding a Terrain Extender when creating Psychic Terrain (by any means), the effect lasts for 8 turns instead of 5.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.shortEffect: Inflicts damage based on the target’s Defense, not Special Defense.
psyshock.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Damage calculation always uses the target’s Defense, regardless of this move’s damage class.

rain-dance.name: Rain Dance
rain-dance.shortEffect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
rain-dance.effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Solar Beam has half power. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.shortEffect: Reduces damage from physical attacks by half.
reflect.effect: Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from physical attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier. If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns. Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

rest.name: Rest
rest.shortEffect: User sleeps for two turns, completely healing itself.
rest.effect: User falls to sleep and immediately regains all its HP. If the user has another major status effect, sleep will replace it. The user will always wake up after two turns, or one turn with Early Bird. This move fails if the Pokémon cannot fall asleep due to Uproar, Insomnia, or Vital Spirit. It also fails if the Pokémon is at full health or is already asleep.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.shortEffect: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
reversal.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP. 64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

roar.name: Roar
roar.shortEffect: Immediately ends wild battles. Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.
roar.effect: Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately. Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

rock-blast.name: Rock Blast
rock-blast.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
rock-slide.shortEffect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
rock-slide.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

rock-tomb.name: Rock Tomb
rock-tomb.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
rock-tomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

sand-tomb.name: Sand Tomb
sand-tomb.shortEffect: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
sand-tomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.shortEffect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
sandstorm.effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

scald.name: Scald
scald.shortEffect: Has a chance to burn the target.
scald.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

scale-shot.name: Scale Shot
scale-shot.shortEffect: Boosts the user’s Speed and lowers their Defense by one stage after inflicting damage two to five times in a row.
scale-shot.effect: Inflicts regular damage two to five times in a row, raising the user’s Speed and lowering the user’s Defense by one stage each upon last hit.

scary-face.name: Scary Face
scary-face.shortEffect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
scary-face.effect: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

scorching-sands.name: Scorching Sands
scorching-sands.shortEffect: Has a chance to burn the target.
scorching-sands.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

seed-bomb.name: Seed Bomb
seed-bomb.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

shadow-ball.name: Shadow Ball
shadow-ball.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
shadow-ball.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

shadow-claw.name: Shadow Claw
shadow-claw.shortEffect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
shadow-claw.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

skill-swap.name: Skill Swap
skill-swap.effect: User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.

skitter-smack.name: Skitter Smack
skitter-smack.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

sleep-talk.name: Sleep Talk
sleep-talk.shortEffect: Randomly uses one of the user’s other three moves. Only works if the user is sleeping.
sleep-talk.effect: Only usable if the user is sleeping. Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves. Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP. This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar. If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

sludge-bomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludge-bomb.shortEffect: Has a chance to poison the target.
sludge-bomb.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave
sludge-wave.shortEffect: Has a chance to poison the target.
sludge-wave.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

smack-down.name: Smack Down
smack-down.shortEffect: Removes any immunity to Ground damage.
smack-down.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the target’s immunity to Ground-type damage. This effect removes any existing Ground immunity due to Levitate, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, and causes the target’s Flying type to be ignored when it takes Ground damage. If the target isn’t immune to Ground damage, this move will fail. This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, and ends the effect of Bounce or Fly.

smart-strike.name: Smart Strike
smart-strike.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
snarl.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

solar-beam.name: Solar Beam
solar-beam.shortEffect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
solar-beam.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

solar-blade.name: Solar Blade
solar-blade.shortEffect: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
solar-blade.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.shortEffect: Scatters Spikes, hurting opposing Pokémon that switch in.
spikes.effect: Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP. Pokémon immune to Ground moves are immune to this damage, except during Gravity. Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP. Wonder Guard does not block damage from this effect. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog removes this effect from its target’s side of the field.

spite.name: Spite
spite.shortEffect: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.
spite.effect: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.

stealth-rock.name: Stealth Rock
stealth-rock.shortEffect: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
stealth-rock.effect: Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

steel-beam.name: Steel Beam
steel-beam.shortEffect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up.
steel-beam.effect: Inflicts damage, and the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP, rounded up. The user still takes damage if the move is blocked by Protect or Substitute, misses, or if the target has Flash Fire.

stomping-tantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stomping-tantrum.shortEffect: Has double power if the user’s last move failed.
stomping-tantrum.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is doubled if the user’s last move failed for any reason (i.e., produced the message "But it failed!") or was ineffective due to types.

stone-edge.name: Stone Edge
stone-edge.shortEffect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
stone-edge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

stored-power.name: Stored Power
stored-power.shortEffect: Power is higher the more the user’s stats have been raised, to a maximum of 31×.
stored-power.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Power is increased by 100% its original value for every stage any of the user’s stats have been raised. Accuracy, evasion, and lowered stats do not affect this move’s power. For a Pokémon with all five stats modified to +6, this move’s power is 31×.

struggle-bug.name: Struggle Bug
struggle-bug.shortEffect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.
struggle-bug.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.shortEffect: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
substitute.effect: Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

sunny-day.name: Sunny Day
sunny-day.shortEffect: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
sunny-day.effect: Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

super-fang.name: Super Fang
super-fang.shortEffect: Inflicts damage equal to half the target’s HP.
super-fang.effect: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

surf.name: Surf
surf.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
surf.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

swift.name: Swift
swift.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

swords-dance.name: Swords Dance
swords-dance.shortEffect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.
swords-dance.effect: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.shortEffect: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
tailwind.effect: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

take-down.name: Take Down
take-down.shortEffect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
take-down.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.shortEffect: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
taunt.effect: Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging. Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used. Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.

thief.name: Thief
thief.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

throat-chop.name: Throat Chop
throat-chop.shortEffect: Prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
throat-chop.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Silences the target for two turns, preventing it from using any sound-based moves.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

thunder-fang.name: Thunder Fang
thunder-fang.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
thunder-fang.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

thunder-punch.name: Thunder Punch
thunder-punch.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunder-punch.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
thunderbolt.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.shortEffect: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.
toxic.effect: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.

toxic-spikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxic-spikes.shortEffect: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.
toxic-spikes.effect: Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity. If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed. Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field. This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar. Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.

trick.name: Trick
trick.effect: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

trick-room.name: Trick Room
trick-room.shortEffect: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.
trick-room.effect: For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect. Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect.

triple-axel.name: Triple Axel
triple-axel.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

u-turn.name: U Turn
u-turn.shortEffect: User must switch out after attacking.
u-turn.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.shortEffect: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
uproar.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends. Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

vacuum-wave.name: Vacuum Wave
vacuum-wave.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.shortEffect: Inflicts double damage if the target is Poisoned.
venoshock.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is poisoned, this move has double power.

volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
volt-switch.shortEffect: User must switch out after attacking.
volt-switch.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

water-pledge.name: Water Pledge
water-pledge.shortEffect: With Grass Pledge, halves opposing Pokémon’s Speed for four turns.
water-pledge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a friendly Pokémon used Grass Pledge earlier this turn, all opposing Pokémon have halved Speed for four turns (including this one).

water-pulse.name: Water Pulse
water-pulse.shortEffect: Has a chance to confuse the target.
water-pulse.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.shortEffect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

weather-ball.name: Weather Ball
weather-ball.shortEffect: If there be weather, this move has doubled power and the weather’s type.
weather-ball.effect: Inflicts regular damage. If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move. Shadow Sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.shortEffect: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.
whirlpool.effect: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

wild-charge.name: Wild Charge
wild-charge.shortEffect: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
wild-charge.effect: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

x-scissor.name: X Scissor
x-scissor.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zen-headbutt.shortEffect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
zen-headbutt.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.
